Requirement: The UI shall group controls by mode (Teleop/Teach/Playback) and hide irrelevant controls when not active.
Notes: Category: UI layout. Source: index.html UI concepts.
Verification activities: Inspection: switch mode; verify only relevant controls visible.

Requirement: The mode selector shall be accessible with one click and display current mode prominently.
The UI shall validate numeric inputs and show inline errors without crashing.
Verification activities: Test: enter invalid value; error shown; no motion.

Requirement: Teleop view shall allow dragging a target marker in the XY plane with cursor feedback.
Teleop view shall allow adjusting Z via wheel and slider with configurable step size.
Verification activities: Test: wheel increments by configured step.

Requirement: The UI shall provide a speed scaling control with numeric readout.
Verification activities: Test: adjust changes speed multiplier used.

Requirement: The UI shall provide a prominent Stop button that remains visible in all modes.
Verification activities: Test: stop visible and halts motion in teleop and playback.

Requirement: The UI shall provide an Emergency Stop control and show E-stop latched state.
Verification activities: Test: E-stop latches until reset procedure.

Requirement: The UI shall provide a Home button and show when home is in progress/completed.
Verification activities: Test: home button disabled during home motion.

Requirement: The UI shall show joint angles and/or PWM values in a diagnostics pane.
The UI shall include a routine list with create/rename/delete actions.
The UI shall prevent destructive actions without confirmation (delete routine, reset config).
Teach mode shall show a waypoint list with add/edit/remove controls.
Verification activities: Test: can add and remove waypoints.

Requirement: Waypoint editor shall allow inline editing of dwell time and validate ranges.
Waypoint list shall support reordering via buttons or drag and drop.
Waypoint names with identical text shall share a consistent colour tag in the UI.
Verification activities: Test: same name -> same colour; persisted across sessions.

Requirement: The UI shall allow grouping waypoints into named subroutines.
Playback mode shall show a timeline list of subroutines/dwell items.
Verification activities: Test: timeline list displayed and editable.

Requirement: Timeline editor shall support add/reorder/delete items.
Playback controls shall include Start, Pause, Resume, and Cancel.
Playback view shall show progress (current step, total steps).
The UI shall provide a calibration/setup panel for servo offsets and limits.
Verification activities: Test: adjust and save offset; restart keeps it.

Requirement: Calibration panel shall include a required steps checklist.
The UI shall support full-screen mode and responsive layout scaling.
Verification activities: Test: resize window; layout remains usable.

Requirement: The UI shall use small compact input fields with labels above inputs to maximize list space.
Verification activities: Inspection: label above input, compact sizing.

Requirement: The UI shall provide a 'dry-run' toggle that simulates motion and logs commands without actuating motors.
Verification activities: Test: dry-run runs without sending PWM outputs.

Requirement: The UI shall display a simple workspace visual (bounds + target marker) when enabled.
The UI shall provide per-joint jog buttons with configurable increment step.
Comms loss shall be detected via timeout and transition to fault state.
Verification activities: Test: unplug triggers fault within timeout.

Requirement: Robot geometry parameters (link lengths, offsets) shall be stored in a single configuration file.
Verification activities: Inspection: parameters exist and are referenced.

Requirement: Geometry parameters shall use consistent units and state the unit in comments or doc.
Forward kinematics shall compute end-effector position from joint angles.
Verification activities: Unit test: FK matches known pose within tolerance.

Requirement: Inverse kinematics shall compute joint angles from XYZ target and return success/failure.
IK shall reject solutions that violate joint limits.
Verification activities: Unit test: solution outside limits rejected.

Requirement: The planner shall publish commanded joint targets and computed XYZ for UI updates.
Verification activities: Test: UI updates at least 10 Hz.

Requirement: The tool/gripper length offset shall be configurable and applied in kinematics.
Verification activities: Test: offset changes reachable workspace accordingly.

Requirement: The system shall support direct move-to-target in teleop using incremental updates (not a single step).
Verification activities: Test: drag results in incremental commands.

Requirement: The planner shall avoid queue buildup by dropping intermediate teleop targets when new target arrives.
Verification activities: Test: rapid drags do not create backlog.

Requirement: The system shall treat angles consistently (degrees vs radians) and convert internally as needed.
Routine files shall be stored as JSON with a schema_version field.
Each waypoint shall store pose, dwell time, and optional IO actions.
Waypoint dwell time shall be validated to be non-negative.
Waypoint pose shall be stored in a consistent representation (joint angles or XYZ) with explicit flag.
Routine manager shall assign stable unique ids to routines independent of display names.
Saving a routine shall be atomic (temp file then replace).
Verification activities: Test: interruption leaves old routine intact.

Requirement: Teach recorder shall capture waypoint from current commanded pose at capture time.
Verification activities: Test: captured pose matches UI pose at capture moment.

Requirement: Teach recorder shall allow adding a waypoint without moving the robot (snapshot).
Verification activities: Test: can capture current pose as waypoint.

Requirement: Waypoint editor shall allow editing dwell time
Verification activities: Test: waypoint speed affects segment time.

Requirement: Waypoint editor shall allow deleting a waypoint
Waypoint list shall allow reordering and reflect in playback order.
Timeline file shall be stored as JSON with schema_version and updated_at timestamp.
Timeline editor shall allow adding routines from routine list into timeline.
Timeline editor shall allow reordering and deleting items.
Timeline engine shall execute items sequentially and stop on fault or stop command.
Timeline engine shall support pausing and resuming with state preserved.
Verification activities: Test: pause mid-run then resume completes.

Requirement: Timeline engine shall support cancel that stops immediately and clears queue.
Verification activities: Test: cancel stops and clears queue.

Requirement: Timeline engine shall support looping
The system shall allow specifying gripper open/close actions at waypoints.
The system shall prevent teleop commands from affecting the robot during playback unless Stop/Cancel.
The system shall provide a routine preview list before execution showing waypoints and dwell times.
The system shall provide an estimated duration for routines and timelines (optional).
Verification activities: Test: estimate close to measured time.

Requirement: The system shall support 'record from teleop' workflow with a clear recording indicator to avoid accidental capture.
Verification activities: Test: indicator toggles and waypoints captured only when active.

Requirement: Teleop shall drop intermediate targets when new targets arrive (latest wins).
Verification activities: Test: rapid updates do not create lag.

Requirement: Software shall clamp PWM outputs to configured safe ranges.
Controller shall support gripper control channel command.
Controller shall support LED control channels or a status byte for LED driver.
Verification activities: Test: LED states set via protocol.

Requirement: Wiring diagram shall include mapping of controller pins/channels to servos, gripper, LEDs.
The LED control show o set logical states: ready, running, teach, fault.
Verification activities: Unit test: set states updates snapshot.

Requirement: LED patterns shall support solid and blink with configurable blink period.
The system shall read a JSON decribing the colour of each LED output and their pin via config.
Verification activities: Test: load LED mapping JSON; verify outputs map to correct pins/channels.
